verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's docs describe deployable hosted or self-hosted scanners that continuously track key status and route findings to alerts, which is a form of background automation. The evidence does not show user-defined automations, schedules or agentic workflows. Pre-commit hooks are event-triggered checks, not autonomous background jobs. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable scheduled or recurring automations, details on how continuous scanning is configured, agent-driven autonomous workflows, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: TruffleHog continuously tracks the status of all key types to identify whether remediation has occurred.
Deploy hosted or self-hosted scanners, scan your critical systems for secrets, and notify the right teams to remediate and rotate.
Route findings to Slack, Jira, email, or webhooks so the right people can act on them.
